page.overview:
Who is Dream Stooges?

The Dream Stooges are three demon brothers in Final Fantasy VI: Laragorn, Curlax, and Moebius. They are devourers of souls who attack through dreams.

When the party visited Doma Castle with Cyan and stayed the night, Cyan did not wake up come morning. As the party tried to rouse him, they sensed the presence of the Dream Stooges and they bounced into the room, announcing their names and intent to steal Cyan's soul. They leapt into Cyan and the party followed.

One of the party members awoke in the Dreamscape. Their two allies had been abducted by the Dream Stooges, forcing the lone party member to search the Dreamscape for them. One of the Dream Stooges guarded each of the others but they fled when confronted, unwilling to fight without their brothers. When the party was reunited they went to the exit of the Dreamscape that had been sealed by the Dream Stooges, who had also come together. The two trios battled and the Dream Stooges were destroyed, allowing the party to proceed deeper into the Dreamscape.

Laragorn, Moebius and Curlax are fought as bosses within the Dreamscape.
